Jordan Spieth Golf Swing - Face On Super Slow Motion
I wish I could swing like that, every time I try I end up topping the ball and nearly falling over.

His swing (and Bubba's) is proof that you don't need mechanics to hit a golf ball. I have admittedly become too much a player of golf swing and not golf, but I'm working really hard to just feel again. It's tough. No wonder Tiger is in such a bad place right now.

That 2nd half uber slow motion is freaking awesome.

Regarding his swing and the leg stability on the backswing, I have to remind myself that he's only 21 and I can't hope to get back there without being looser in the lower half at this stage of my life.

On the downswing, I do try to mimic his hand position, as well as getting the legs and hips involved like he does best I can.

My swing coach actually told me to use the DVR and rewind these slow mos on TV when I see them, watch them a few times before going back to live golf. The technology is really cool.
